name: Sunrise Carpool Circle
description: Daily 8 AM pool from Sector 32 to the North Gate. Four seats, split fuel cost, WhatsApp group for last-minute swaps.

name: Campus Rideshare Club
description: Student-run pool with 40+ members covering Model Town, Sarabha Nagar, and BRS Nagar routes on a rotating schedule.

name: Late-Night Library Lift
description: Volunteer drivers cover the 10 PM library closing slot so no one has to walk back to their PG alone.

name: Weekend Station Pool
description: Shared cabs to Ludhiana Junction every Friday evening and Sunday night, booked a day ahead through the sign-up sheet.

name: Green Nest PG (Girls)
description: AC and non-AC rooms, home-style meals twice a day, 5 minutes from the north gate with a strict 11 PM entry.

name: Shivalik Boys PG
description: Shared and single rooms with power backup and Wi-Fi included. Common room has a TV and table tennis.

name: Sunview Residency
description: Newly built rooms with attached washrooms and a rooftop study deck. Slightly pricier but very quiet.

name: Budget Rooms Near Gate 2
description: No-frills sharing rooms, cheapest option within walking distance, water and electricity included in rent.

name: Bhullar's Chole Kulche
description: The 4 PM queue tells you everything — spicy chole, buttery kulche, and a chutney worth writing home about.

name: Midnight Maggi Point
description: Open till 2 AM during exam season. Cheese Maggi, cold coffee, and the only lights still on after midnight.
address: Hostel Road, next to Block D

name: Campus Café Aroma
description: Sit-down café with actual chairs, decent Wi-Fi, and filter coffee strong enough to survive a 9 AM lecture.

name: Punjabi Tadka Dhaba
description: Thali-style meals with unlimited roti. Best value for a proper dinner when the mess menu disappoints.

name: Sharma Xerox & Stationery
description: Same-day spiral binding, cheapest per-page printing near campus, and a shopkeeper who remembers your usual order.

name: Quick Print Hub
description: Colour printing, lamination, and project-report binding with a 15-minute turnaround before submission deadlines.

name: Bright Notebooks & Art Supplies
description: Everything for design and architecture students — sketchbooks, markers, scale rulers, and drafting sheets.

name: Gate 3 Photocopy Point
description: Tucked behind the bus stop — easy to miss, but the only place open before 8 AM lectures.

name: Campus Threads
description: Hoodies, department tees, and hostel-block merch printed while you wait. Custom orders for fests and farewells.

name: Alter & Tailor Express
description: Same-day hemming and fitting for interview blazers and fest outfits. Honest about what can and can't be fixed.

name: Winter Wear Warehouse
description: Bulk-priced jackets and thermals every October — the one place that stocks sizes above XL reliably.

name: Sneaker Studio
description: Repairs, cleaning, and a small resale rack for gently used sneakers. Also does last-minute lace swaps before sports day.

name: Fix It Fast — Laptop & Phone Repair
description: Screen swaps, battery replacements, and virus cleanups with a genuine same-day turnaround for most models.

name: Cable & Charger Corner
description: The place to buy a replacement charger at 9 PM without paying delivery-app markup.

name: PixelFix Screen Repair
description: Specialises in cracked-screen replacements with a 30-day warranty and OEM-grade parts.

name: Byte Size IT Solutions
description: Software installs, printer setup, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting for hostel rooms — student discount with an ID card.
